holder-quote: Xherw saw Yelroan tap his final data point. The [Mathematician]’s eyes traced the geographical map and his gaze turned distant.
effect-quote: [Visualize Data Set]. Yet the Skill proved the math was right, not the other way around. His murmur was satisfied.
Instantly, the piece of paper turned into a little, floating graph.

holder-quote: Yelroan lowered his head. His sunglasses flashed in the light now pooling around them.
effect-quote: Let’s see who they really are, not just numbers.
